_comment: One question per call (JUDGE_SINGLE=1). _active lists the items actually scored: an item that answers the same way regardless of the image is not a checklist item, it is a constant, and it dilutes the ones that work. Measured on the ablation ladder with Qwen2.5-VL-72B-AWQ.

_inactive_because.equal_wheels: always true — says the wheels match on the wheels-unequal rung too
_inactive_because.steering: always false — cannot see the fork even on the gold bicycle
_inactive_because.drivetrain: always false — cannot see the chain even on the gold bicycle

_suffix: Reply with only the word true or the word false.
is_bicycle: Is this drawing recognisable as a bicycle?
two_wheels: Does this drawing show exactly two wheel-like round shapes, both fully drawn?
closed_frame: Do the straight lines between the wheels form a closed shape with no gaps?
equal_wheels: Are the two wheels in this drawing the same size, within about 20%?
steering: Is a handlebar or fork drawn connecting to the front wheel?
drivetrain: Is a chain, chainring or crank drawn between the frame and the rear wheel?
